papers.title_en: PanoGraphGS: Unifying Panoptic Segmentation and Hierarchical 3D Scene Graphs with Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Jinghan Gao, Siyu Wang, Dongyu Feng, Yiyuan Pan, Rong Xiong
papers.evidence: 联合全景分割与层级三维场景图，将语义区域、实例及空间关系组织起来
papers.tldr: 三维场景图可为语言引导导航提供实体、归属和空间关系信息，但构图依赖跨视角一致的语义区域与物体实例识别。PanoGraphGS在共享三维高斯几何上联合学习语义和实例特征，并据此构建楼层、房间、物体等层级及其关系。实验显示，它在Replica和NaviGS上的物体节点准确率平均超过最强基线逾50个百分点，二维全景分割也优于所评方法。研究还发布包含高斯、网格、图像、语义与深度数据的NaviGS数据集，为层级三维理解提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene graphs support language-guided navigation by organizing physical entities and their containment and spatial relations into hierarchical maps. Building such structured maps requires a scene representation that consistently distinguishes semantic regions and object instances across viewpoints. To this end, we present PanoGraphGS, a unified framework that integrates panoptic 3D Gaussian representation learning with hierarchical 3D scene graph construction. The framework learns semantic and instance features on shared Gaussian geometry. Prototype-based semantic learning and association-based instance learning produce consistent panoptic predictions across viewpoints. The learned representation supports novel-view panoptic segmentation and direct Gaussian-level panoptic decoding. A semantic-aware scene graph module further recovers a floor-room-stuff-object hierarchy with containment and spatial relations. We further release NaviGS, a real-world dataset for panoramic scene understanding. The dataset provides 3DGS, mesh, RGB, semantic, and depth data. For 3D scene graph identification, PanoGraphGS outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline in object-node accuracy by more than 50\% points on average across Replica and NaviGS. PanoGraphGS also achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods in 2D panoptic segmentation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of PanoGraphGS in both hierarchical 3D scene understanding and 2D panoptic segmentation. The project website is available at: https://github.com/gaojh0333/PanoGraphGS.

papers.title_en: VisibilitySplat: Ray-Traced Occlusion for Relighting with 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Sven Kluge, Oliver Staadt
papers.evidence: 通过三维高斯泼溅进行材质与光照分解
papers.tldr: 3D高斯泼溅具备高效渲染与交互优势，但缺少显式遮挡建模，使基于物理的重光照及材质、光照分解面临困难。本文在保留原有光栅化训练流程的同时，引入由包围体层次结构加速的点式光线追踪器，稀疏查询不同光照方向的透射率加权遮挡，并结合微表面BRDF与低分辨率HDR环境光。TensoIR合成数据实验显示，方法在新视角合成、反照率重建和重光照上具竞争力，并优于若干早期基线；消融验证显式可见性有助于重光照与材质—照明解耦。该设计以稀疏可见性查询补足光栅化泼溅，为高效逆渲染提供兼顾实用性与物理一致性的方案。
papers.abstract_en: We address inverse rendering with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) by introducing explicit visibility modeling for relighting as well as material and light decomposition. Our approach augments the standard rasterized 3DGS pipeline with a sparse visibility oracle that estimates transmittance-weighted occlusion for Gaussian primitives from sampled lighting directions. This oracle is implemented using a point-based ray tracer accelerated by a bounding volume hierarchy (BVH) and queried sparsely within the inverse-rendering objectives, while the original 3DGS loop is retained for training efficiency, interactive visualization, and tooling compatibility. Shading follows a physically based rendering (PBR) formulation with a principled microfacet bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF) and low-resolution high-dynamic-range (HDR) environment maps. We evaluate our method on the TensoIR synthetic dataset against baselines based on neural radiance fields (NeRFs), tensor representations, and 3DGS. The results show competitive performance and improvements over several earlier baselines for novel-view synthesis (NVS), albedo reconstruction, and relighting. Ablations indicate that explicit visibility modeling is an important contributor to relighting and material-illumination disentanglement, while pure PBR supervision can favor appearance fitting in NVS. Overall, the findings suggest that sparse, point-based visibility queries effectively complement rasterized splatting for inverse rendering while preserving the practical advantages of the 3DGS ecosystem.

papers.title_en: RoboCloth: A Large-Scale Real Cloth Material Dataset for Neural Reflectance Reconstruction
papers.authors: Zhen Li, Haoran Qin, Francesco Di Sario, Daniel Rebain, Andrea Tagliasacchi
papers.evidence: 从多视角与多光照图像恢复布料反射和材质特性
papers.tldr: 真实布料反射随视角和光照变化复杂，现有测量数据难以充分支撑神经材质重建与泛化。RoboCloth以机器人控制相机和光源，采集500种布料、每种约580帧高动态范围图像，并提供校准、几何及结构化反射观测。方法先用全数据训练共享解码器学习材质先验，再冻结解码器，为目标材料拟合2048×2048潜变量纹理。在自建留出材料和UBO2014上，该解码器优于既有实测数据模型与解析式物理渲染拟合，且无需修改即可迁移至新采集系统。数据与划分公开，推动布料神经反射重建研究。
papers.abstract_en: We present RoboCloth, a dataset of 500 real cloth materials captured under flexible, calibrated camera and lighting configurations, where both are robotically controlled during acquisition. Each material is imaged in approximately 580 high-dynamic range frames spanning a wide view-light hemisphere; camera poses are refined via structure-from-motion and aligned to the robot frame, yielding per-material sparse surface geometry and structured per-point reflectance observations ready for neural material training. We demonstrate the value of this data through a two-stage neural reconstruction pipeline: Stage 1 trains a shared MLP decoder on our corpus to learn cloth material priors; Stage 2 then freezes the decoder and fits a dense 2048x2048 latent texture to each target material. Evaluating on held-out materials from our own dataset and on the independent UBO2014 benchmark, we show that a decoder trained on our captures outperforms decoders trained on existing measured reflectance datasets and analytic PBR fitting, transferring to unseen acquisition systems without modification. The dataset, calibration files, observation tensors, and train/test splits are released under CC BY 4.0 on the Hugging Face Hub.

papers.title_en: Physical AI: Concepts, Techniques, and Challenges
papers.authors: Weinan Zhang, Chunhua Shen, Tianfan Xue, Bin Zhao, Bingqi Jiang, Zihan Guo, Zicai Cui, Yang Li, Ming Zhou, Xinyuan Chen, Lihe Ding, Xiao Chen, Yujin Wang, Shi Guo, Junting Dong, Tao Lu, Xing Shen, Haoyu Guo, Yao Mu, Haiyong Yu, Haoxiang Ma, Fuxian Huang, Qiaojun Yu, Yunsong Zhou, Kailin Li, Zirui Wang, Yufei Xue, Weishuai Zeng, Tao Huang, Zhigang Wang, Junli Liu, Pengyuan Wu, Pingrui Zhang, Haotian Wang, Dongzhan Zhou, Jiafei Cao, Feng Yuan, Xinyi Ye, Quanli Xuan, Mulin Yu, Shangding Gu, Kaiwen Song, Dong Wang, Jiarui Li, Kehui Liu, Zhongjie Jia, Dongjiang Li, Jiacheng Bao, Haoran Yang, Zhaoqing Chen, Yiming Sun, Bowen Zhou
papers.evidence: 构建物理人工智能统一框架，涵盖感知、建模与物理世界行动
papers.tldr: 物理人工智能发展迅速，但定义、技术版图和核心挑战尚无共识，亟需系统梳理。本文将其界定为在现实约束下，通过连续反馈感知、建模并作用于物理世界的人工系统，并与数字人工智能、具身智能、信息物理系统及数字孪生加以区分。文章综述多模态感知、物理数据与仿真、世界模型、具身基础模型、运动控制、多智能体协作和软硬件协同，并覆盖机器人、制造等应用。最后聚焦仿真到现实迁移、可靠性、安全与长期部署，提出推动通用物理智能发展的挑战与方向。
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, physical artificial intelligence (physical AI) has experienced rapid development, capturing significant attention in academia and industry. However, the field has yet to reach consensus on its definition, technical landscape, and core challenges. To address this gap, this monograph seeks to define physical AI, present its technical landscape, and examine each key technical subfield in depth. In doing so, it establishes a unified framework for Physical AI: artificial systems that perceive, model, and act upon the physical world through continuous feedback under real-world constraints. Further, this monograph distinguishes physical AI from conventional digital AI, embodied AI, cyber-physical systems, and digital twins. It develops the foundations of physical AI across physics, control, cognition, learning, and reasoning. It reviews key methodologies, including multimodal perception, physical data and simulation, world models, embodied foundation models, motor-control systems, multi-agent coordination, and hardware-software co-design. Furthermore, it examines applications spanning robotics, manufacturing, infrastructure, scientific experimentation, and autonomous services. Particular attention is given to sim-to-real transfer, reliability, real-time execution, evaluation, safety, governance, and long-term deployment. By connecting perception, prediction, decision-making, action, and adaptation in a closed loop, this monograph identifies the technical challenges and research directions required to advance from narrow automation toward more generalizable physical AI and, ultimately, physical artificial general intelligence (Physical AGI).

papers.title_en: HiQGS: Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Querying for Feed-Forward Gaussian Reconstruction
papers.authors: Qiaowei Miao, Qifeng Cheng, Yijing Guo, Yuru Xiao, Ziqian Ni, Sheng Yang
papers.evidence: 层级时空查询用于稀疏图像的前馈高斯场景重建
papers.tldr: 稀疏带位姿单目帧中的视角和时间共同变化，使前馈高斯重建难以整合不同尺度、视点与时刻的证据。既有方法要么将高斯分配紧密绑定单帧，要么缺少按目标时刻组织观测信息的机制。HiQGS提出层级时空编码器，依图像位置、观测时间和相机位姿组织多分辨率几何与外观特征，并由时间自适应解码器按目标时刻查询证据、预测场景高斯状态。在静态和动态场景基准上，该方法取得较强渲染质量与几何精度，说明层级视觉编码与目标时刻感知查询有助于提升稀疏观测重建。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction from sparse posed monocular frames requires reasoning over observations that vary jointly in viewpoint and time. Existing methods either predict Gaussian primitives from observation-aligned features or aggregate multi-frame information through compact latent queries. However, the former tightly couples Gaussian allocation to individual frames, while the latter does not explicitly structure observed evidence according to its temporal relation to the requested timestamp. Consequently, evidence across spatial scales, viewpoints, and timestamps can be difficult to align and integrate. We present \textbf{HiQGS}, a query-based hierarchical framework for feed-forward Gaussian scene reconstruction from sparse monocular frames. HiQGS introduces a \textbf{Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Encoder} that organizes multi-resolution geometry-appearance visual features according to image location, observation time, and camera pose, thereby preserving complementary appearance and structural cues. Our \textbf{Time-Adaptive Decoder} use target timestamp queries the resulting hierarchical representation to retrieve relevant spatiotemporal evidence and predicts the corresponding Gaussian scene state. Experiments on static and dynamic scene reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate strong rendering quality and geometric accuracy, validating the effectiveness of hierarchical visual encoding and target-time-aware Gaussian querying.

papers.title_en: Spherical Geometry-Aware Panoptic Scene Graph Generation for Equirectangular Panoramas
papers.authors: Zhe Wu, Xiaoyan Fei, Xinyi Jiang, Yanxu Wei, Junming Rao, Yihong Yan, Xuewei Li
papers.evidence: 结合分割掩码与关系推理的全景场景图方法
papers.tldr: 全景图采用等距柱状投影时，畸变、纬度相关的像素面积差异和图像接缝会干扰全景场景图生成。本文提出球面几何感知的两阶段框架：融合重叠透视视图预测，并结合球面面积感知聚合、加权无关系监督与双经度分数融合进行关系推理。研究还构建了包含340张高分辨率全景图的数据集，标注10,571个节点和6,632条有向关系。实验中，球面融合使匹配视图下PQ提升36.03%，完整框架使预测分割条件下的mR@50提升52.99%，显示球面几何建模对全景场景图生成具有显著价值。
papers.abstract_en: Panoptic scene graph generation (PSGG) represents scene entities with segmentation masks and directed relations. Equirectangular projection (ERP) panoramas challenge PSGG through distortion, latitude-dependent pixel areas, and an artificial seam. We propose a two-stage spherical geometry-aware framework that fuses overlapping perspective-view predictions using observation reliability, spherical overlap, and angular proximity. Relation reasoning combines spherical-area-aware aggregation, weighted no-relation supervision, and dual-longitude score fusion. We also construct a dataset of 340 high-resolution panoramas with 10,571 nodes and 6,632 directed relations. Against corresponding baselines, spherical fusion improves PQ by 36.03% under matched views, while relation reasoning improves mR@50 by 11.20% under PredCls with ground-truth masks and object labels. The full framework improves mR@50 by 52.99% under SGDet with predicted panoptic segments. These results demonstrate the value of spherical geometry for panoramic PSGG.

papers.title_en: PointForward V2: Point-Aligned Interaction for Feedforward Driving Reconstruction
papers.authors: Xianqi Wang, Cheng Chi, Yuechuan Pu, Hongcheng Luo, Junda Cheng, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Bing Wang, Xin Yang
papers.evidence: 改进前馈多视图三维场景重建中的点查询交互
papers.tldr: 动态驾驶场景前馈重建需要融合多视角、多时刻观测，但既有点查询交互有限，直接进行全局注意力又难以扩展。PointForward V2以场景结构化寄存器为中介，让静态背景跨帧汇聚信息，并使动态实例在物体中心坐标中交互，结合空间对齐与原始时间戳编码。该方法无需稠密全局注意力，即可对提升后的三维点查询开展时空推理。在Waymo、nuScenes和Argoverse 2上取得领先表现，推动点对齐表示走向可扩展的点对齐交互。
papers.abstract_en: Feedforward reconstruction of dynamic driving scenes requires integrating observations across multiple views and time steps into a coherent 3D representation. PointForward established state-of-the-art feedforward driving reconstruction by lifting image observations into sparse 3D queries, demonstrating the effectiveness of point-aligned scene representations. However, these queries are largely processed independently, limiting information exchange across space and time, while direct global attention among tens of thousands of point queries is computationally prohibitive. In this work, we present \textbf{PointForward V2}, which advances point-aligned representation to point-aligned interaction. Our key idea is to mediate query interaction through compact, scene-structured registers. For the static background, frame-wise Static Scene Registers compress point information, communicate across frames, and propagate the aggregated context back to the queries. For each dynamic instance, queries from different frames are aligned in an object-centric canonical space and interact through instance-specific Dynamic Instance Registers. We further employ 4D positional encoding that combines aligned spatial coordinates with original timestamps, enabling spatially aligned yet temporally distinguishable interactions. In this way, PointForward V2 enables scalable spatio-temporal reasoning directly among lifted 3D queries without dense global attention. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and Argoverse 2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across large-scale driving benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Physical Canvas: A Vision Tactile World Model For Robot Policy Evaluation And Learning
papers.authors: Zebin Xing, Yuhang Zheng, Yupeng Zheng, Yichen Zhang, Zichen Li, Shangqing Zhou, Yujie Zang, Yuchen Liu, Zhongpu Xia, Haoran Li, Qichao Zhang
papers.evidence: 利用视觉触觉世界模型评估并训练机器人操作策略
papers.tldr: 机器人策略的真实交互评估与后训练成本高、难扩展，而仅生成逼真画面的世界模型可能错误呈现接触动力学，导致反馈不可靠。PhysCanvas 将多视角 RGB、触觉图像与标记位移、任务状态和动作统一建模，并用动作运动图像及参考观测约束生成。结合场景、模态和状态奖励模型进行一致性后训练后，四项任务的成功率相关性均值由0.602升至0.885；奖励引导策略后训练使π0.5真实成功率由59.1%升至70.8%。该方法为接触丰富操作提供更可信的闭环评估与学习途径。
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating and post-training robot policies through physical interaction is costly and difficult to scale, motivating action-conditioned world models as interactive simulators. However, visually plausible predictions can misrepresent contact dynamics, providing unreliable feedback for policy evaluation and learning. We introduce PhysCanvas, a state-consistent visuo-tactile world model for contact-rich robot manipulation. PhysCanvas unifies multi-view RGB, tactile images, marker displacement, task state, and actions within a unified vision space. All modalities share a video VAE and pretrained generative backbone, allowing optical touch to reuse visual and temporal priors. Motion images derived through forward kinematics and camera projection provide spatially aligned action conditioning, while an initial RGB anchor and updated reference observations guide sequential generation. Our consistency-aware post-training uses the frozen Scene Reward Model, Modality Reward Model, and State Reward Model to supervise scene preservation, visual-tactile compatibility, and agreement with real task outcomes. The resulting world model supports closed-loop policy rollouts for evaluation and provides imagined interactions and rewards for GRPO policy updates. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, when policies are rolled out in the world model, State Reward Model supervision increases the arithmetic mean of task-wise Pearson correlations between world-model and real-world success rates from 0.602 to 0.885. Policy post-training in the reward-guided world model further increases $π_{0.5}$'s mean real-world success rate from a 59.1% SFT baseline to 70.8%. These results demonstrate the value of unified multimodal modeling and consistency-aware post-training for robot policy evaluation and learning. Project page: https://zebinx.github.io/PhysCanvas_HomePage/.

papers.title_en: How Firm Should a Grasp Be?
papers.authors: Matthew Beveridge, Shree K. Nayar
papers.evidence: 通过视觉触觉数据实时估计物体弹性与摩擦等属性
papers.tldr: 机器人抓取需要足够稳固以防物体滑落，同时又要避免施力过大造成损伤；但物体质量、弹性和表面摩擦等属性往往事先未知。研究提出结合视觉与触觉的实时估计方法，在抓取过程中推断这些材料属性，并据此确定处理物体所需的最小抓力。作者采集了带有形状及物理属性实测数据的果蔬物体集，并利用仿真构建抓力估计模型。平行夹爪机器人实验表明，该系统能针对多种物体调整抓力，实现轻柔抓取，为未知物体的安全操作提供了方法。
papers.abstract_en: An ideal robot grasp is firm enough to securely handle an object, yet gentle enough to avoid damaging it. Achieving this balance requires knowledge of the object's material properties, such as its mass, elasticity, and surface friction. These properties, however, are seldom precisely known a priori. In this work, we propose a visuotactile approach to estimating material properties in real time, during the process of grasping. Our method uses these estimated properties to determine the minimum grasp force required to handle the object. We contribute a new dataset of real-world objects (fruits and vegetables) with measured physical properties (shape, mass, elasticity, and friction), which we use to construct our force estimation model via simulations. We experimentally validate our approach to grasp force control using a robot with a parallel-jaw gripper. We demonstrate our system's ability to gently grasp a wide variety of objects, in each case adapting to their unique physical properties.

papers.title_en: Robotic Photography System based on Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.authors: Song-Li Wu, Chubin Zhang, Wenbo Ding, Yansong Tang
papers.evidence: 视觉语言动作模型联合感知与相机控制，实现真实环境中的机器人摄影
papers.tldr: 机器人摄影不仅要理解拍摄意图，还需在复杂环境中规划相机运动并兼顾成片美感，分离式感知与控制难以统一满足这些要求。研究提出 RoboPhoto-VLA，将视觉、语言理解、推理与相机控制纳入统一框架，并以 PhotoCoT 进行结构化动作规划、以审美直接偏好优化对齐人类审美。作者构建含语言引导示范的 OpenPhotography 数据集用于训练与评测。真实环境实验显示，该系统生成的照片更符合人类审美，并能迁移至未见主体、视角、姿态及复杂摄影指令，为自主机器人摄影提供统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: Modern robotic photography requires understanding photographic intent, planning camera motions, and producing aesthetically pleasing images in complex environments. We present RoboPhoto-VLA, a unified Vision-Language-Action framework that jointly models perception, reasoning, and camera control for autonomous robotic photography. RoboPhoto-VLA incorporates PhotoCoT for structured action planning and Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization (ADPO) to align camera behaviors with human aesthetic preferences. To facilitate training and evaluation, we construct OpenPhotography, a robotic photography dataset with language-guided demonstrations. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that RoboPhoto-VLA produces photographs better aligned with human aesthetic preferences while generalizing effectively to unseen subjects, viewpoints, poses, and complex photographic instructions.

papers.title_en: Causal Spatiotemporal State Evolution for Monocular 4D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Qiaowei Miao, Yijing Guo, Lipei Zhang, Qifeng Cheng, Yuru Xiao, Ziqian Ni, Sheng Yang
papers.evidence: 前馈式单目四维几何重建，改进动态场景的时序状态建模。
papers.tldr: 单目视频四维重建需要从静态几何估计走向对场景随时间演化的建模，但无序时间聚合及几何、运动分离监督，容易导致状态转移不稳定和时序漂移。本文提出因果时空曼巴，通过时空与空时互补扫描，沿时间方向持续传播几何感知状态。统一运动监督则结合相机和深度预测构造符合三维结构的前向运动场，显式约束跨帧转移。该方法在动态基准的深度、位姿和光流任务上取得先进表现，为一致、稳定的四维场景表示提供了统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: While feed-forward models excel in static 3D geometry estimation, extending them to dynamic 4D scenes requires modeling visual geometry as a causally evolving state. Current methods typically rely on unordered temporal aggregation, which lacks the directional structure of physical time. Furthermore, existing supervision often treats geometry and motion as disjoint objectives, failing to exploit their inherent physical coupling. Consequently, they lack a unified constraint to effectively supervise temporal state transitions, leading to inconsistent 4D scene representations. To address this, we propose a feed-forward framework for causal 4D visual geometry learning from monocular videos. At its core, Causal Spatiotemporal Mamba augments temporal aggregation with directional state propagation. Through complementary Temporal-Spatial and Spatial-Temporal Scans, CSM continuously propagates geometry-aware states across frames to model spatiotemporal evolution. To align this causal state evolution with observable dynamics, we introduce Unified Motion Supervision. Rather than treating motion as an independent objective, UMS leverages geometry-aware predictions from the camera and depth heads to construct a unified forward motion field that is consistent with the underlying 3D structure. This geometry-grounded supervision explicitly constrains inter-frame state transitions, enabling stable states propagation across frames. Extensive evaluations on dynamic benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across video depth, camera pose, and optical flow estimation. These results validate that the synergy between the directional state propagation of Causal Spatiotemporal Mamba and Unified Motion Supervision effectively captures continuous scene evolution, significantly reducing temporal drift and reinforcing spatial-temporal consistency in 4D representation learning.

papers.title_en: SchemaPose: RGB-Based Category-Level Pose Estimation with Parametric Category Schema
papers.authors: Shuang Wu, Jiude Wei, Cewu Lu, Jianhua Sun
papers.evidence: 从RGB图像估计类别级物体三维姿态、平移和尺寸
papers.tldr: 单目RGB类别级九维位姿估计需要适应未见物体实例，并联合推断三维平移、旋转和尺寸。仅凭外观学习时，类别共享规律与实例结构差异相互纠缠，缺少直接几何约束，使现有方法难以形成契合估计目标的表征。SchemaPose引入参数化类别模式，显式描述类别规律和结构化实例变化，并以推断出的模式变量引导端到端查询式位姿预测；同一框架还支持模板实例化、合成标注与位姿学习。在合成及真实数据上，该方法达到RGB类别级九维位姿估计的领先性能，为统一建模共性、差异与姿态提供了新途径。
papers.abstract_en: RGB-based category-level 9D pose estimation remains highly challenging because a monocular system must generalize across unseen object instances while jointly inferring 3D translation, 3D rotation, and 3D size. Unlike instance-level pose estimation, the category-level setting requires the network to learn both what is shared across objects within a category and how individual instances vary in structure. This challenge is amplified in the RGB-only setting, where pose cues, category-level commonality, and instance-specific variation are entangled in appearance without direct geometric constraints, making it difficult for existing frameworks to learn a representation that is truly aligned with the category-level estimation objective. To address this problem, we propose SchemaPose, a schema-guided framework for RGB-based category-level pose estimation. SchemaPose equips the estimation pipeline with an explicit parametric schema for modeling category-level regularities together with structured instance variation, and uses the inferred schema variables to guide pose-related prediction in an end-to-end query-based framework. The same formulation also supports template instantiation, synthetic annotation, and pose learning within a unified framework. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that SchemaPose achieves state-of-the-art performance among RGB-based methods for category-level 9D pose estimation.

papers.title_en: SUPRA-TEX: 3D Generation with Super-Aligned Texture
papers.authors: Chen Yang, Jiemin Fang, Fanpeng Meng, Zihao Huang, Jichen Pang, Guanjun Wu, Zhikuan Bao, Qi Tian
papers.evidence: 从图像估计可重光照材质并用于三维对象生成
papers.tldr: 单张图像生成三维资产，需要在可重光照材质下保留参考图可见细节，并合理补全不可见表面；既有方法常因多视角预测不一致产生融合伪影，或难以保住细节。SUPRA-Tex将可见材质估计、表面对齐与三维补全拆分，先预测光照分离的PBR贴图，再把可见区域编码为生成空间中的固定观测锚点，引导模型交替更新未观测区和全表面。该设计在可见区域实现与参考图高度对齐，并生成连贯的隐藏表面。仅用公开数据训练，方法在几何条件纹理生成和端到端资产生成上达到最先进表现，且在真实图像上可匹敌甚至超过领先商业系统，提升单图三维生成的保真度与完整性。
papers.abstract_en: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image. Existing methods either introduce artifacts when fusing inconsistent multi-view predictions or struggle to preserve fine details through implicit image-feature conditioning. To resolve these challenges, we introduce SUPRA-Tex, built on the principle of decoupling visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion. This division of labor allows the 3D generator, trained on limited 3D data, to focus its capacity on preserving visible evidence and completing unobserved surfaces. Specifically, we first train an MLLM-based image editing model to predict lighting-separated PBR maps in the reference view. We then project these maps onto the visible surface and encode them with the pretrained material VAE encoder into native observation latents that share the generation target's latent space. An interleaved flow transformer holds these latents as fixed, read-only anchors while alternating unobserved-region and full-surface updates to generate complete material latents. This design achieves super-alignment with the reference, delivering What You See Is What You Get fidelity on visible regions and coherent completion on unobserved surfaces. Trained solely on public datasets, SUPRA-Tex achieves SOTA performance in both geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation, matching or even exceeding leading commercial systems on in-the-wild images. Project page: https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/

papers.title_en: SAP-Depth: Scene-Adaptive Probability Framework for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.authors: Bowen He, Li Zhang, Yujie Chen, Chang Cheng
papers.evidence: 直接进行图像单目深度估计，并以多尺度概率解码恢复几何细节
papers.tldr: 自监督单目深度估计仍常丢失细节，也难以适应不同场景结构，复杂边界的恢复尤其困难。SAP-Depth依据输入图像上下文，用可学习参数预测器生成场景自适应的动态深度区间，并由逐区间概率解码器融合多尺度特征，预测稠密深度概率分布。KITTI实验显示模型在准确性上优于现有先进方法，且更能保留复杂边缘细节；Make3D测试进一步验证其泛化能力与鲁棒性。该框架以场景特定的概率建模提升结构恢复，为自监督深度估计提供了适应性方案。
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation remains challenging due to the loss of fine-grained details and limited adaptability to varying scene structures. In this paper, we propose SAP-Depth, a novel architecture based on Scene-Adaptive Probabilistic. Unlike traditional methods, we introduce a Dynamic Bins mechanism powered by a Learnable Parameter Predictor, which adaptively estimates scene-specific depth distributions conditioned on the input image context. Furthermore, a Bin-wise Probability Distribution Decoder is designed to effectively fuse multi-scale representations to predict dense depth probability distributions, significantly enhancing boundary sharpness and structural recovery. Through the collaborative coupling of these proposed modules, our model achieves dynamic prediction of scene-specific depth distributions. Extensive experiments on the KITTI dataset show that SAP-Depth outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in accuracy, particularly in its ability to better preserve complex edge details. Further, tests on the Make3D dataset validate the model's excellent generalization capability and robustness.

papers.title_en: RxGS: Relightable Gaussian Stylization via BRDF Decomposition
papers.authors: Wanrong Hong, Liu Jiang, Mukesh Prasad, Jun Li
papers.evidence: 利用BRDF分解处理材质反射与光照，支持可重照明场景外观
papers.tldr: 现有参考图驱动的三维场景风格化通常把材质反射、光照与视角效应混合写入单点颜色，导致结果难以在新光照下重打光。RxGS基于具备 BRDF 属性的三维高斯表示，仅优化逆渲染得到的漫反射反照率，并固定粗糙度、金属度、法线和环境光。方法结合近邻特征匹配损失与高斯中心空间平滑先验，迁移参考图外观并约束空间一致性。实验以光流扭曲误差构造几何一致性代价，在所有 NeRF-Synthetic 场景取得最低值，真实采集场景也具竞争力，同时保留重打光能力。
papers.abstract_en: Reference-based 3D scene stylization transfers the appearance of a reference image onto a reconstructed 3D scene while preserving scene geometry. Recent methods perform this transfer by optimizing the appearance representation of neural scene models including Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). These methods optimize an RGB appearance representation, in which a single per-point colour combines the effects of material reflectance, environment illumination, together with the shading it produces, and the viewing direction. When stylization modifies this combined colour, the illumination effects present during stylization are baked into the stored appearance, so the stylized scene cannot be rendered under different illumination. To address this limitation, we present RxGS, a relightable 3D scene stylization framework built on a Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF)-aware 3D Gaussian representation. Rather than modifying a per-point RGB colour, RxGS optimizes only the diffuse albedo field recovered by inverse rendering, while leaving roughness, metallicity, surface normals, and the estimated environment lighting unchanged. As a result, the stylized scene keeps all the components a physically-based renderer needs other than the edited albedo, and can therefore still be relit. RxGS optimizes the albedo field using a nearest-neighbour feature matching loss together with a spatial smoothness prior over Gaussian centres. We evaluate the method using a Geometry Consistency Cost (GCC) based on optical-flow warping error. RxGS achieves the lowest GCC on all evaluated NeRF-Synthetic scenes and remains competitive on real-captured scenes, while additionally supporting relightable stylization, which existing reference-based 3D scene stylization methods do not provide.

papers.title_en: Real-Time Radar Semantic and Panoptic Scene Understanding
papers.authors: Santosh Parit, Julia Hindel, Rohit Mohan, Georgi Pramatarov, Paul Newman, Daniele De Martini, Abhinav Valada
papers.evidence: 面向流式雷达数据的实时语义与全景场景分割
papers.tldr: 自动驾驶需要在恶劣天气和弱光中保持稳定感知，FMCW旋转雷达虽有远距、全天候优势，却面临回波复杂、标注稀缺和实时处理困难。论文提出StreamRPS，利用激光雷达场景补全自动生成标签，并以雷达专用层次化Transformer实现流式语义与全景分割。模型通过各向异性嵌入、轴向极坐标注意力和方位旋转增强适配雷达数据。在SAX与BOREAS上，性能至少超过最强基线1.4个百分点，四扇区处理速度超过400帧每秒。作者还发布100帧人工标注，为独立评估和后续研究提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: Robust scene understanding under varying environmental conditions is essential for safe autonomous driving. While cameras and LiDAR degrade in adverse weather and poor lighting, Frequency-Modulated Continuous-Wave (FMCW) spinning radar provides dependable 360° perception at extended ranges with minimal compute cost. However, real-time FMCW radar scene understanding is challenging due to complex signal returns, limited temporal resolution, and scarce annotated datasets. We introduce StreamRPS, a novel framework for streaming FMCW radar panoptic segmentation, comprising an automated label-generation pipeline via LiDAR scene completion and a real-time streaming network for semantic and panoptic segmentation. Our encoder-decoder streaming architecture comprises a radar-specific hierarchical Transformer encoder and task-specific decoders for semantic or panoptic prediction. Our encoder introduces a stem to capture range-dependent signatures, anisotropic patch embeddings to preserve angular resolution, and axial polar attention to separately model the periodic azimuth and bounded range axes. We further introduce azimuth roll rotation augmentation to simulate ego-vehicle rotation during training. Comprehensive experiments on the SAX and BOREAS datasets validate both our auto-labeling methodology and streaming segmentation network against established baselines. We outperform the strongest baseline by at least 1.4pp while processing sectors at over 400 FPS in a 4-sector streaming setting. We additionally provide manual annotations for 100 SAX radar scans, enabling independent evaluation of the entire framework.

papers.title_en: TriFold: Folding irregular 3D Gaussians into structured latents for 3D Scene Generation
papers.authors: Yun Wang, Chiyu Wang, Fan Jiang, Ziyu Zhu, Zhaoxu Sun, Guangchi Fang, Mu Xu, Dapeng Wu
papers.evidence: 将三维高斯场景编码为结构化潜变量并联合重建几何与外观
papers.tldr: 复杂场景的原生3D高斯表示因基元数量不一、空间密度不均，以及邻近基元的几何与外观差异较大，难以学习紧凑的生成表征。TriFold提出原生3D高斯变分自编码器，将场景编码为固定布局的三平面潜变量，并联合重建几何和外观。编码端以逐单元学习查询聚合多个槽位，解码端预测占据区域，再通过集合预测与候选筛选恢复数量可变的高斯集合。实验显示，该方法能高保真重建场景，并支持点云条件生成及单图条件的完整场景生成，为原生高斯场景表示学习提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in 3D generation has motivated growing interest in compact generative representations of complex 3D scenes. For native 3D Gaussian scenes, however, learning such representations remains challenging due to widely varying primitive counts, nonuniform spatial density, and differences in geometry and appearance even among spatially neighboring primitives. In this work, we introduce TriFold, a native 3D Gaussian VAE that encodes Gaussian scenes into a fixed-layout triplane latent and jointly reconstructs their geometry and appearance. The key insight is to impose structural regularity on the latent space while preserving the spatial adaptivity of the underlying Gaussians. During encoding, we use cell-wise learned queries to aggregate projected Gaussians into multiple slots per cell, reducing the information loss caused by single-feature pooling. During decoding, occupancy prediction identifies active regions, where query-based set prediction and candidate selection reconstruct local Gaussian sets with spatially varying primitive counts. Building on this representation, we train a latent flow-matching model for conditional scene-level 3DGS generation, enabling point-cloud-conditioned synthesis and single-image-conditioned amodal generation. Experiments demonstrate that TriFold achieves high-fidelity reconstruction and generation from a single image that provides only a partial observation of the scene, validating its effectiveness for native 3D Gaussian representation learning. https://fantasy-amap.github.io/TriFold

papers.title_en: A 3D-Driven Framework for Moving-Camera Perspective-to-360° Video Generation
papers.authors: Michael Wakeham, Mrinmoy Kumar Das, Wenqi Wang, Ayush Tewari, Boqing Gong, Deepti Ghadiyaram
papers.evidence: 从移动相机视频显式重建三维场景，作为视角一致视频生成的共享表示。
papers.tldr: 将移动相机拍摄的透视视频转换为全景视频，不仅要补全输入画面外的内容，还须保留随时间出现的观测，并确保视点改变时场景一致。论文提出模块化三维驱动框架，以共享场景表示连接专门组件：显式重建输入观测，再由预训练全景图像模型补全选定全景视图中的未知区域。生成内容被提升到三维场景并空间锚定，因此可随相机视点变化保持一致。在 Argus 静态场景子集上，该方法无需额外全景视频训练，仍取得领先的输入视角保真度、感知质量和几何一致性，为此类任务提供了直接生成视频之外的思路。
papers.abstract_en: Turning a moving-camera perspective video into a 360° video requires more than just generating content outside the input frame: observations revealed over time must be preserved, unseen regions completed, and the resulting scene kept consistent as the camera viewpoint changes. Existing methods assign these different requirements to a single conditional video model, requiring them to be jointly learned from panoramic video data. We instead present a modular, 3D-driven framework that distributes these three responsibilities across specialized components, all connected through a shared scene representation. Input observations are reconstructed explicitly in 3D, while a pretrained panoramic image model completes unobserved content from a selected panoramic render. This generated content is lifted into the shared 3D scene, where it remains spatially anchored across camera viewpoints. Without requiring any additional panoramic-video training, our framework achieves state-of-the-art input-view fidelity, perceptual quality, and geometric consistency on a static-scene subset of the Argus evaluation set. These results support our decomposed, 3D-driven formulation as a promising alternative to direct video generation in this setting.

papers.title_en: SpaRV: Sparse Radiance Voxels for Scalable Geometrically Consistent LiDAR-Visual Mapping and Rendering
papers.authors: Jianheng Liu, Yunfei Wan, Fangming Cheng, Xiangyu Hong, Zuhao Zou, Haotian Li, Longji Yin, Chunran Zheng, Jiarong Lin, Fu Zhang
papers.evidence: 激光雷达视觉几何一致映射与场景重建
papers.tldr: 机器人导航与仿真需要兼具真实外观和准确几何的场景地图，但任务轨迹视角有限，容易留下几何欠约束；相机位姿和焦距误差会使纹理模糊，大场景还受显存容量限制。SpaRV提出可微渲染的稀疏辐射体素地图，引入激光雷达深度、占据约束及平滑正则，并交替优化地图和相机参数；通过分层八叉树按子地图分配分辨率，控制训练与渲染开销。实验表明其提升轨迹外几何一致性并锐化纹理，单张24GB显卡即可重建包含63,582张图像的校园，支持其他相机与激光雷达的模拟。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic simulation, navigation, and inspection need photorealistic and geometrically accurate maps. Radiance fields achieve photorealism, but building them from robot data raises three challenges. A robot's trajectory serves its task, not reconstruction, so images from few viewpoints leave the geometry under-constrained. Residual errors in camera poses and intrinsics blur the map. The map's GPU memory grows with scene size, which limits its level of detail in large scenes. We present \textbf{SpaRV}, a \textbf{Spa}rse \textbf{R}adiance \textbf{V}oxel map rendered by differentiable ray marching, which lets irregular LiDAR scans supervise it alongside images. LiDAR depth and occupancy anchor the under-constrained geometry, and normal and smoothness regularizers keep it smooth between LiDAR points. To correct camera errors, SpaRV alternates map training with photometric optimization of the camera poses and focal lengths. To bound GPU memory in training and rendering, SpaRV holds one submap at a time at full resolution and the rest at coarser octree levels. Experiments show that SpaRV keeps the geometry consistent away from the captured trajectory and sharpens textures by optimizing the camera parameters. On one 24\,GB GPU, SpaRV reconstructs a university campus captured in 63{,}582 images and simulates other cameras and LiDARs. Our code will be released at \url{https://github.com/hku-mars/SpaRV}.

papers.title_en: A Matlab/Octave package for photometric stereo 3D reconstruction
papers.authors: Alessandro Buccini, Elisa Crabu, Federica Pes, Giuseppe Rodriguez
papers.evidence: 提供用于光度立体三维重建的Matlab/Octave软件包
papers.tldr: 光度立体可从不同光照下的图像恢复物体三维形状，但其理想表面与场景几何等假设在真实应用中往往不成立，反射也会引入重建误差。本文更新 Matlab/Octave 工具包 ps3d，使其能在多种条件下实现和测试光度立体模型。新版加入面向反射表面的替代模型，并提供指标评估数据集对模型假设的符合程度。用户可用合成或实验数据检验不同观测配置，为模型适用性分析及反射场景重建提供实用工具。
papers.abstract_en: The photometric stereo model allows the construction of 3D virtual replicas of real objects from images acquired under different light conditions. The assumptions of this model are strongly restrictive and are seldom fully satisfied in applications. Indeed, the surface of the observed objects may deviate from ideal conditions, and the geometry of the scene is often only an approximation of the one assumed by the model. Additionally, real-world surfaces may present reflection phenomena, which introduce distortions in reconstructions. In this paper, we present a revised version of the Matlab package \ttt{\small ps3d}~\cite{cdfrv21}, developed to implement the photometric stereo model under various conditions. The new package contains various extensions, the most notable one is the presence of an alternative model to address the presence of a reflective object surface. In addition, it implements particular metrics to analyze the compliance of a dataset to model assumptions, and it is compatible with GNU Octave. The tool allows users to test the model under different observation configurations, also in presence of reflection, using either synthetic or experimental data.

papers.title_en: Counting Contributions, Not Views: Occlusion-Aware Densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Marcel Rogge, René Schuster, Didier Stricker
papers.evidence: 改进三维高斯场景的几何致密化，可用于表面重建方法
papers.tldr: 3D Gaussian Splatting依靠渲染统计进行自适应增密，但视锥可见性过滤无法识别遮挡，导致未实际贡献的高斯也被计为观测，稀释梯度并压制遮挡区域的增密。本文在基于StopThePop的框架中引入遮挡感知过滤，只用高斯实际参与渲染的视角统计，并以平均贡献量替代原始视图数归一化。遮挡密集场景中，各项图像质量指标均优于遮挡盲基线，LPIPS最高降低6%，所需高斯数不足视图数归一化方法的一半。该方法还能在长训练中控制高斯数量，并在小型基准上以较少高斯保持竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting grows a dense scene from a sparse initialization through adaptive density control (ADC), driven by per-Gaussian statistics gathered during rendering. These statistics pass a frustum-based visibility filter blind to occlusion: fully occluded Gaussians still count as observed, diluting the averaged gradient signal and suppressing densification precisely where geometry is occluded. We correct this with an occlusion-aware filter that restricts densification statistics to views in which a Gaussian actually contributes, and replace the criterion's raw view-count normalizer with an average-contribution one. Integrated into a StopThePop-based framework, the two together improve every image-quality metric over the occlusion-blind baseline on occlusion-heavy scenes (up to 6% lower LPIPS), at less than half the Gaussians a view-count normalizer requires. Under the longer schedules these large scenes require, the count stays bounded where most criteria diverge, and on smaller benchmarks our method stays competitive at a fraction of the competitors' count.

papers.title_en: MatchCityLoc: Aerial Localization in LoD City Models via Surface Normal Matching
papers.authors: Oussema Dhaouadi, Zuria Bauer, Johannes Michael Meier, Marc Pollefeys, Daniel Cremers, Olaf Wysocki
papers.evidence: 利用表面法线匹配进行城市环境中的无人机定位，支持几何视觉与机器人导航需求。
papers.tldr: 城市中GNSS常不可靠，无人机需要视觉定位；传统依赖二维轮廓重叠的方案在抽象、无纹理LoD城市模型上容易出现几何歧义。MatchCityLoc从带噪六自由度位姿先验出发，用零样本基础模型从查询图像提取表面法线，并与渲染的LoD法线匹配，建立三维到二维对应，再通过PnP求姿并迭代渲染匹配进行细化。实验显示，在评估的现成LoD定位方法中，该方法以很少渲染取得较强位姿召回及准确的平移、旋转估计。它缩小航拍影像与无纹理几何之间的模态差异，为轻量、隐私友好的城市模型定位提供有效途径。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) navigation in urban environments requires precise pose estimation. Because Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) signals are often unreliable in cities, visual localization serves as a crucial complement. Within this domain, textureless Level-of-Detail (LoD) city models provide a lightweight and privacy-preserving substitute for heavy 3D textured meshes. However, localizing against abstract geometry is challenging. Existing pipelines typically score 2D silhouette overlaps, which can suffer from severe geometric ambiguities. We present MatchCityLoc, a framework that shifts this paradigm to direct feature matching from a noisy 6-DoF pose prior. By extracting surface normals from the query image using a zero-shot foundation model and matching them against rendered LoD normals, we establish explicit 3D-to-2D correspondences. This enables a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) pose solve, which we iteratively refine through a render-and-match loop. Experiments demonstrate strong pose recall and accurate translation and rotation among the evaluated off-the-shelf LoD-based methods with very few renderings. By bridging the modality gap between aerial imagery and texture-free geometry, MatchCityLoc enables accurate localization using lightweight, privacy-preserving city models.

papers.title_en: LLM2R: From Large Language Models to 3D Reassemblers
papers.authors: Zhouhan Zhong, Qiuhong Shen, Xingyi Yang, Jinyi Xu, Xinchao Wang
papers.evidence: 从部件几何预测刚体变换以重建完整三维形状
papers.tldr: 三维部件装配需要从未组装的部件集合中恢复完整形状，但每个部件的位姿通常不能仅由自身几何确定，部件增多也使成对推理和迭代验证难以扩展。LLM2R 将任务建模为序列预测，以 Point-BERT 和 Q-Former 编码部件，并借助因果语言模型及末尾摘要令牌整合全局信息。它在多个基准上取得领先指标，且部件越多优势越明显；在百部件测试中显著超过对比方法，并能零样本迁移至未见类别。该方法以单次非自回归推理预测全部位姿，为大规模语义与几何装配提供了统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: 3D part assembly aims to reconstruct a complete shape from a set of unassembled parts by predicting a rigid SE(3) transformation for each part. Because the placement of a part is rarely determined by its own geometry, the task demands reasoning over the entire part set, and existing methods, which rely on pairwise relations or iterative generation and verification, scale poorly to objects with many parts. We present LLM2R, which casts part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only large language model (LLM): a Point-BERT encoder and a Q-Former compress each part into a block of geometric tokens, the blocks of all parts are concatenated, and a causal LLM adapted with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) processes the sequence in one forward pass. Causal attention, however, lets the hidden states of a part observe only the parts that precede it. LLM2R therefore appends a block of learnable summary tokens after the last part: these tokens follow every part, so their states aggregate the whole assembly at a constant token cost, and a part-aware pose head fuses each part's states with them before predicting its rotation and translation. One architecture thus handles semantic and geometric assembly and predicts all poses in a single non-autoregressive pass. LLM2R achieves the highest part accuracy and success rate on all three PartNet categories, the best rotation error, translation error, and part accuracy on PartNeXt, and the lowest translation error and fastest inference on Breaking Bad, where only a fracture-specialized method is more accurate. Its advantage grows with the number of parts: at 100 parts it exceeds GARF by 33.5 points in part accuracy on Breaking Bad and Assembler by 29.1 points on PartNet, and it transfers zero-shot to unseen categories with more than 16 points higher part accuracy than the strongest of three baselines.

papers.title_en: Orbia: Do Generated Videos Form a Consistent 3D World?
papers.authors: Dongyue Lu, Guian Fang, Hur Lim, Yonggang Wu, Yanrong Wang, Hongshan Chen, Shengju Qian, Yue Liao, Wei Chow, Lingdong Kong, Tianxin Huang, Yu Yang, Hongji Yang, Junchao Huang, Ao Liang, Yihao Wang, Zihan Wang, Rong Li, Hanlin Chen, Xin Wang, Wei Tsang Ooi, Mike Zheng Shou, Shuicheng Yan
papers.evidence: 评测交互式世界模型的三维一致性
papers.tldr: 视频生成模型可用于交互式探索与模拟，但画面逼真并不代表跨视角、跨时间维持同一三维世界，现有评测覆盖有限。Orbia通过受控探索和重访，从输入保真、生成内容持久性及三维自洽性三方面系统测量。基准整合公开数据、自采场景和仿真，共含720个室内外实例、六种协议，并评测27种模型。它为定位三维不一致、推动更持久可靠的视频世界模型提供统一依据。
papers.abstract_en: Video generators serve as interactive worlds for exploration and simulation, yet realistic and visually appealing frames do not necessarily depict a consistent 3D world. Existing benchmarks assess selected geometric properties or use vision-language models to judge memory and consistency, leaving systematic 3D evaluation underexplored. We introduce Orbia, the first benchmark dedicated to a systematic and comprehensive evaluation of 3D consistency in interactive world models. Through controlled exploration and revisit, we organize the evaluation into three dimensions: input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency. For input preservation, registered RGB-D references and annotated anchors support appearance, geometry, and spatial stability measurements. For generated-content persistence, we compare revisits to regions absent from the input image with their first generated observations to test whether models preserve what they create. For 3D self-consistency, cross-view depth and feature correspondence, regional scale agreement, and held-out Gaussian rendering test whether generated views describe the same 3D scene. Minute-long exploration and revisits further test long-term consistency. Our construction and annotation pipeline brings together public datasets, self-captured scenes, and simulation, yielding 720 instances across indoor and outdoor environments and six exploration-and-revisit protocols. Evaluation spans 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models through native-interface adapters. Our Orbia benchmark provides a systematic basis for diagnosing 3D inconsistency and developing more persistent video world models.

papers.title_en: VesperMUSE: Multi-Modal Fusion Vision Transformer for Image Semantic Segmentation Under Diverse Light Conditions
papers.authors: Raul Balmez
papers.evidence: 视觉变换器用于自主系统场景理解中的语义分割
papers.tldr: 低光环境中的噪声、伪影、色彩失真与结构细节丢失，会使语义分割性能下降，影响自主系统导航和场景理解。VesperMUSE以物理先验合成低光样本，并借助热成像增强图像，再融合RGB特征、热表示和表面法线。其可扩展、模态无关的注意力机制选择性利用跨模态线索，无需因传感器配置变化而修改网络架构。论文报告该方法能恢复缺失视觉信息，在多种光照条件下表现出竞争力，为复杂真实环境中的机器感知提供灵活方案。
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation is critical for the reliable navigation and scene understanding of autonomous systems, yet its performance degrades severely in low-light environments due to noise, artifacts, colour distortion, and the loss of structural details. To address this challenge, this work introduces VesperMUSE, a unified multi-modal framework designed to achieve robust image semantic segmentation across diverse illumination conditions. The architecture addresses the light deficiency problem on multiple levels: proposing a novel physics-informed synthetic low-light adaptation algorithm, approaching Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE) through a thermal-guided paradigm, and finally aiming to recover the intrinsic scene details for semantic segmentation through a multi-modal fusion approach. Following enhancement, the framework dynamically integrates the primary RGB features with auxiliary thermal representations and surface normal maps highlighting geometric discontinuities and material boundaries. At the core of this integration is a highly scalable, modality-agnostic self-attention mechanism that extracts both global context and fine local features from an arbitrary number of auxiliary inputs. By combining and projecting these hierarchical multi-modal representations into a unified component, the attention module allows the network to selectively attend to relevant cross-modal cues without requiring any architectural modifications when different sensor configurations are used. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that VesperMUSE successfully recovers missing visual cues, providing a flexible, state-of-the-art (SOTA) solution for machine perception in extreme and unstructured real-world environments.

papers.title_en: Learning to Correct Geometry in Generated Videos
papers.authors: Weijie Lyu, Tiancheng Shen, Jason Li, Yujing Wang, Xiaoyuan Wang, Haobo Yuan, Yizhou Zhao, Ming-Hsuan Yang
papers.evidence: 利用合成配对监督校正视频在相机运动下的几何一致性
papers.tldr: 生成视频在镜头运动下常出现结构扭曲、视差不一致，平滑运镜甚至退化为镜头切换；网络视频多由静态或弱运动相机拍摄，视点变化监督因而稀缺。论文提出后处理模型VGC，并构建VG-Pairs：以带相机运动与姿态标注的真实片段作为几何一致目标，通过轨迹自适应关键帧生成失真配对样本。VGC借助光流辅助区分相机与物体运动，无需修改源生成器；在姿态条件和文本驱动基准上提升多种生成器的几何一致性，扩大骨干规模还能增强视频精修能力。该方法以合成配对监督补足数据缺口，为改善生成视频的运镜稳定性提供了通用路径。
papers.abstract_en: Generated videos often lose geometric consistency under camera motion: structures warp under viewpoint change, parallax becomes inconsistent, and smooth camera movement may collapse into shot-like transitions. We argue that this failure is largely a data problem. In web-scale video corpora, most visible motion comes from dynamic objects captured by static or weakly moving cameras, leaving only sparse supervision for viewpoint-induced appearance changes. To address this, we propose Video Geometry Corrector (VGC), a post-hoc video-to-video model trained on synthetic paired supervision. Starting from real videos with diverse camera motion and pose annotations, we construct VG-Pairs with a synthetic paired-supervision data generation pipeline. Each video clip is treated as a geometry-consistent target and paired with a distorted counterpart synthesized by a pretrained image-to-video inpainting model using trajectory-adaptive keyframes. VGC learns to map the distorted input to the geometry-consistent target without modifying the source generator, and uses optical flow as an auxiliary cue to help disentangle camera motion from object motion. Experiments on pose-conditioned and prompt-driven benchmarks show that VGC improves geometric consistency across multiple source generators, and scaling to a larger backbone further extends the framework toward more general video refinement.

papers.title_en: MPIG: Multi-angle Polarization Image Generation from a Single Polarization Observation
papers.authors: Jue Wang, Ruilin Huang, Liquan Shen, Zhen Tian, Xia Hua
papers.evidence: 从单幅偏振观测生成多角度偏振图像，为视觉材质分析补充观测信息。
papers.tldr: 偏振成像有助于材料分析与场景理解，但获取完整偏振信息通常依赖专用硬件和多角度采集，部署成本较高。本文针对仅有0°观测的情形，提出基于Swin Transformer的MPIG，通过跨角度特征交互与残差解码生成45°、90°和135°图像，并以Stokes差异及偏振强度感知监督恢复偏振变化。作者构建含5,474组真实四角度图像的HighPol数据集，模型达到29.729 dB PSNR、0.9505 SSIM和21.514° AoLP平均角误差。玻璃识别与语义分割验证显示生成结果保留任务相关信息，为降低偏振成像硬件门槛提供了可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: Polarization imaging provides informative cues for material analysis, scene understanding, and visual perception. However, acquiring complete polarization observations typically requires specialized hardware and multi-angle measurements, thereby increasing system complexity and limiting practical deployment. In this work, we address the problem of predicting the missing $45^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $135^\circ$ polarization views from a single $0^\circ$ observation by leveraging a learned scene prior. To this end, we propose MPIG (Multi-angle Polarization Image Generation), a Swin Transformer-based framework that couples cross-angle feature interaction with residual decoding to predict angle-dependent intensity variations while preserving shared scene structure. Specifically, measured Stokes differences and polarization-strength-aware supervision guide the recovery of polarization modulation, orientation, and magnitude, while low-rank factorization further reduces the decoding cost. We also construct HighPol, a large-scale real-world polarization dataset comprising 5,474 groups of high-resolution four-angle polarization images collected from diverse indoor and outdoor scenes. Experimental results demonstrate improved image and polarization accuracy, achieving 29.729 dB PSNR, 0.9505 SSIM, and $21.514^\circ$ AoLP MAngE while requiring 85.86 M parameters and 1.126 T FLOPs. Furthermore, downstream validation on glass and semantic-segmentation tasks suggests that the generated polarization images can preserve task-relevant information, demonstrating the effectiveness of MPIG and the practical utility of predicted polarization observations for downstream vision applications.
